evidence.mission_note: As an S52 manual M Roadster priced in the ideal band, this matches the future-keeper brief. It is a keeper purchase, not the bridge, and the keeper case rests on documentation this listing does not yet provide.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes, through photos, a 1998 Z3 M Roadster with a factory manual and stock-appearing green bodywork whose paint presents well in the attached images. The stated 240 hp output fits the US S52. Observed issues are a power top that no longer works electrically (seller converted it to manual) and visible interior wear on the steering wheel, driver-seat bolsters and carpet, plus an aftermarket head unit. There is no VIN, no title photo, no history report and no receipts. The clean-title, brake and tire statements are seller claims only. Both conditional model-critical items, rear-structure and cooling history, are missing; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply to this S52 car. At $16,500 the ask sits at the bottom edge of the $16,508-$20,920 fair-value band. The car has reportedly been listed about a year, so the 72,500-mile figure should be re-confirmed.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, a title photo, trunk-floor and subframe photos, and any cooling or brake receipts, and confirm in writing that a PPI at a Virginia Beach-area BMW specialist will be allowed before any deposit.
